# GitHub Actions paused

GitHub Actions is intentionally paused for this repository while the current
product overhaul is in progress.

No workflow files were present when this pause was recorded. Future workflow
files should be kept in this directory until CI is ready to be enabled again.

To re-enable CI, move the reviewed `*.yml` or `*.yaml` files into
`.github/workflows/`, commit the change, and verify the first run manually.
